Found later, while analysing a related dimension: the retirement of this table's loading process is documented directly in another process's own code, dated shortly before its staging table's last update. The only loading process found for this table is a one-time setup from 2013, the same pattern already found on other dimensions in this project: same author, same alert recipient, same copied error text. This retired process included a landing step and two further steps, none of which were ever put on a recurring schedule
